_about: Explicit operations a regency version needs beyond refreshing untouched scaffold files (library/migrations/README.md, 'Adding a step'). Paths are relative to the project's guidelines root. Kinds: rename (alias move), delete, rewrite (literal replacements in a regency-owned file), mkdir. An op may carry before: one of regency's scripts and its arguments, run with --repo <project> right before it.

ops.why: one store (R12): its rows are imported into the prints table of index.sqlite first; git keeps the file's history
